title: Guitar, mandolin and the family trio serenading
summary: He played guitar, mandolin and drums, and formed a trio with his brothers that serenaded at Gulf Coast hotels for good money.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: What about guitar? How did you play with pigs? Yeah, yeah, pigs. What kind of pigs? Oh, cellar pigs. Would it be a flat pick or a plum pick? Yeah, flat. Flat pick.
Flat pick. Oh, there was a picker. I never had a pick. I had this chord.
You played chords in mandolin. How did you play that? With a flat pick? Yeah.

Played lead on that. I played in mandolin. My brother, Jujus, was playing guitar. And my brother was playing bass, Sylvester. And we had a nice trio. We used to make a lot of money. We used to go around serenading people at the different hotels in Paris Christiane, Luxie, Gulfport. We used to go all around, I think. And, uh, serenading. Go from house to house. We made nice money. Sometimes we used to come back seven, five, eighty dollars. A night. We used to make nice money, I think. Oh, from drums, I wanted to play clarinet. And I had a fellow over there. There was a white fellow. He was a barber. His name is Piku Luzander. He was a clarinet player, and I just liked the way he played it. And I never fooled with clarinet. But, uh, I heard him playing. And I got interested in playing the clarinet. So I kept after my dad at a bar when he kept telling me he wasn't able. Well, I was working. I'd take my own money and buy it, but he wouldn't let me. So, uh, he went up and talked to Piku. And, uh, Piku got him one. And he gave it to me. Well, that one was brand new when he gave me.
